g.text: Can we talk about what you said earlier?
I say a lot of things. Remind me?
Forget what I said. Let's pretend it didn't happen. [End.]
You don't remember? How often do you go around confessing your feelings for people?
Did you mean what you said? Yes or no.
It's not that, I was just hoping *you'd* forget.
I'll cut you some slack because you've had a messed up life. I don't know why you said if you didn't mean it.
I need you to level with me, smartass.
I'll cut you some slack because you've had a messed up life. I don't know why you said if you didn't mean it.
I'm not sure what I expected...
But honestly? I don't care. Don't do it again.
I'm supposed to be "the boss" now, right? The one in charge.
I mean. I showed you my hand. And you peaced out.
I told you how I felt, and you left me hanging.
But honestly? I don't care. Don't do it again.
Things have changed. A lot. In such a short span of time.
Doesn't mean you can't be vulnerable. Trust me.
I'd be a fool not to let myself change with it. To not be willing to at least try.
Don't make my mistakes. Don't let yourself get cold.
When you arrived, I saw someone *just* like me - someone who wasn't really living, just surviving.
And...that's part of what you've shown me since you've arrived.
How cold I've grown. How closed off. Even to my friends.
And that gave me hope. Hope I haven't allowed myself to have in a long time.
So...I had to think. And I'm sorry if that rubbed you the wrong way. But I had to let myself come to terms with the fact that, well.
I feel the same way about you.
So. Shall we make this official? Make this a "thing?"
I'm sorry. I'm not ready for this. [Do not date Arthur.]
Every time I think you can't get any more deranged...
Well, then. Let's see where the future takes us, hm?
I can respect that. Let me know if you change your mind.
I, for one, am looking forward to it for the first time in...ages.
